title: Clippers announce jersey swap for fans in Opening Night twist
text:
The Clippers are trying to rebuild its relationship with the fanbase.
for a new one. The home opener on Oct. 21 will have a special twist for fans as the team kicks off a new era.
Darius Garland #10 of the LA Clippers signs an autograph after the game against the Denver Nuggets during a preseason game. The Clippers just announced that on opening night the first 4,000 fans can swap an old jersey for a new one. Los Angeles Clippers forward Rui Hachimura shoots over Denver Nuggets guard Jamal Murray during the first half of a preseason NBA basketball game.
Los Angeles Clippers guard Keaton Wagler moves the ball as center Isaiah Jackson provides coverage against Denver Nuggets forward Julian Strawther during the second half at Intuit Dome.
“Our fans deserve to hear from us before this, and for that we’re sorry,” Redden said Monday. “We’ve been listening to the thoughts, the concerns, and feeling the emotions of our fan base. They mean everything to us. … We hope to fulfill our promises to them, to build their trust and move forward through this time.
“This franchise often has done its best work with its back against the wall … We hope to represent our fans the same way we always have in dark times, by coming out fighting. ” It appears the latest announcement by the time is another effort by the Clippers to regain the trust of its fans. It’ll be interesting to see how many Kawhi Leonard jerseys are swapped for new ones on Opening Night.
